_note: The learner fills the image placeholder in the editor; the smoke runner does the same substitution with sed before applying. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag. verify-scc-restricted is environment-sensitive: CRC's portless session SCC may differ from a real DCS session, so it is expected to be informative rather than green everywhere.

steps.run: sed -i 's|REPLACE_WITH_HARBOR_IMAGE|${DCS_REGISTRY}/samples/hello-dcs:1.0|' deployment.yaml && envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s
oc set env deploy/hello-dcs --from=configmap/hello-dcs-config && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s
